decision.name: NARROW_READER_ACCEPTANCE_TO_SINGLE_ARTIFACT_AND_ADD_ARCHIVE_DEDUP_RACE_GATE
decision.new_finding: Supervisor 17:50 read-only integration clarification identifies a known single-handoff-artifact consumer. Three-file latest/audit/handoff coherence is therefore diagnostic producer consistency, NOT established production-consumer acceptance. Public storage.atomic_write_json uses tempfile+fsync+os.replace per file, so test single-artifact atomic visibility independently. Public append_observations performs load/dedup then append with no cross-writer lock visible; two writers may both see an empty archive and append the same observation_id. This is a source-derived concurrency risk, NOT an observed incident.
decision.replaces: Do not require all three output files to be same generation as a proxy for known production consumer; retain earlier pinned two-writer test as diagnostic gate only and do not infer deployed reader behavior.

concise_no_network_contract.gate_1_single_artifact: Create complete valid handoff JSON payload A with two correlated generation markers; use storage.atomic_write_json to establish A. Monkeypatch storage.os.replace for handoff destination to pause writer B immediately before replace (after temporary file has been fsynced). During pause read+json.loads target: must be full A. Release B, read target: must be full B. Never accept partial/truncated JSON or mixed fields. This validates public single-file publication only; do not call it a production-consumer test.
concise_no_network_contract.gate_2_archive_dedup: Two threads call storage.append_observations(shared_observations.jsonl,[same_valid_FlowObservation]) with identical observation_id. Wrap storage.load_observations with a two-party Barrier AFTER each load returns to force both to observe the same initial empty archive; on timeout allow serialized-lock path rather than failing just because B was blocked. Join with bounded timeouts, release in finally, assert no exceptions, parse every JSONL row, exactly one persisted observation_id and no duplicate economic event. A pre-fix failure is possible from read/check/append race; do not claim without execution. Repeat with distinct observations and assert both persist exactly once.
concise_no_network_contract.gate_3_diagnostic_only: Optionally retain economically distinct same-clock A/B writer fixture with lock-aware conditional B wait, checking cross-file generation fingerprints as a diagnostic, not a production-reader oracle. Do not use as_of_ms alone for economic identity.
concise_no_network_contract.gate_4_real_consumer: Known consumer is single handoff artifact per Supervisor; no private code copied. Actual consumer/deployed behavior remains NOT_VERIFIED, and any authorized offline harness is separate from this public test. No private/prediction/execution paths may be inspected by Planner A.
concise_no_network_contract.evidence: Pin exact public HEAD and test blob hashes; preserve real stdout/stderr/exit codes; fail closed on any unexpected duplicate, mixed single-file payload or test failure.
